_status: THE INDEPENDENT WATCHDOG. Credential-free: this image holds no request-signing code, so it cannot reach the venue however it is configured. It can assert the halt latch and never clear it. WATCH PATTERN IS A SAFETY PROPERTY, NOT A BUILD PREFERENCE: with no watchPatterns this service redeployed on EVERY push to the branch, which on 2026-10-15T12:13:04Z restarted it in the same second as the executor (executor 4f3d3df6, watchdog ce8e2b6e, both commit 669fb3ac) and left a gap with nothing watching. A supervisor that restarts whenever the supervised process does is not independent. It now deploys only when DEPLOY_TRIGGER changes, exactly as the executor does.
